lixpiValue: high where the model allows it
summary: How hard the model works to preserve fine detail from the input images when editing: faces, logos, text, and other features that a normal edit tends to redraw. low is the API default; high keeps those details noticeably closer to the source.
combines: It costs real money. high adds roughly 4,096 image input tokens for a square input and 6,144 for a non-square one, on top of the normal per-tile cost.
Edit path only. It has no meaning on a pure text-to-image request, which is why openai-provider.ts sends it at :603 and not at :613.
Supported on gpt-image-1 and gpt-image-1.5 and later; gpt-image-1-mini does not accept it.
Lixpi already resolves it per model through imageReferenceCapabilities.inputFidelity, so the value is decided by the model record rather than by the request.

usage.from: imageReferenceCapabilities.inputFidelity on the model record, set per model in the sync workload
usage.what: How hard the model works to match the faces and style in reference images. Only sent on the edit path, since there are no references to be faithful to otherwise.
